name: Morning sit · Thai forest (about 28 min)
summary: Settle with the first steps of Ajaan Lee’s Method 2, sit twenty minutes with Method 1 (bud-dho and the bases), close with a short goodwill reflection from the Karaṇīya Metta Sutta.

transition.note: each later practice’s opening bowl becomes a chime; one bowl at the start, two at the end
